title: Frances W NDE 2245
content: I was above my body and watching everything going on in the room. I could see my father at my bedside crying. I was confused as to why I was lying in the bed and suddenly was in a long tunnel with a small light at the end. I started to race through the tunnel at an amazing speed and the light became stronger and stronger. The feeling as I approached the light was of complete peace and love I cannot describe. I could feel a presence at my side on both sides of me. I knew they were heavenly beings. As I came into the light, I was filled with an indescribable love and peace. I did not speak with my mouth but telepathically. I was shown my life on earth, the beginning to now, and I was shown the impact I had on others I connected to, I could feel their feelings and experiences in how I treated them. I was filled with total knowledge and understood everything. I entered a beautiful garden, the colors and scenery I could never explain. The colors were surreal. I never wanted to leave this place. The peace was complete; I understood my purpose on this earth. God spoke to me, but I could not see him, I was stopped, if I went any further, I could not go back to earth. I had a choice to return or stay but I wanted to stay, God wanted me to go back and told me my purpose was not finished on this earth, I would have children. I wanted to do God's will. I told God I wanted to stay but in my heart to do his will was stronger. I knew I would be back; I entered my body quickly like bang. I was in the hospital. I was told I was tied to the bed, as the convulsions were so bad they had to tie me down. The doctors were amazed I made it. This experience changed me forever. I always had faith. Today I can say absolutely God is real, Jesus is real, and love is all that matters! Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: June,1989 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Criminal attack Other PARTY AND SOMEONE SPUNKED MY PUNCH WITH THREE HITS OF ACID. My punch drink was spiked and someone at the dance fed me enough alcohol to kill me by itself. My heart stopped, after the event the doctor said it is a miracle that I am alive today. How do you consider the content of your experience? Wonderful Did you feel separated from your body? Yes I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal Total clarity, no worries, pain, suffering, like lead on earth and a feather in heaven. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? When I was shown the full knowledge, this was taken away from me to a certain extent for me to live here on this earth. Were your thoughts speeded up? Incredibly fast Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Everything seemed to be happening all at once Time is different in heaven is as if it does not exist as earth, one minute in heaven could be ten years on earth. Were your senses more vivid than usual? Incredibly more so Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Everything was clear and bright, color does not exist on this planet as it is in heaven. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Telepathically. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? Neither Did you pass into or through a tunnel? Yes Long tunnel, light at end, brighter and brighter, as got closer brilliant light. Did you see any beings in your experience? Sensed their presence Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? Yes Angels. Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see an unearthly light? Yes Brilliant light. Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? Clearly mystical or unearthly realm GARDEN What emotions did you feel during the experience? Peace, love, completeness, understanding, and unreal. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Incredible joy Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? United, one with the world Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about the universe Did scenes from your past come back to you? Past flashed before me, out of my control Full life here on earth and how I affected others around me, we are all connected as one. My future to some degree. Did scenes from the future come to you? From the world's future I was shown all things. Did you come to a border or point of no return? A barrier I was not permitted to cross; or 'sent back' to life involuntarily God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Moderate Have your religious practices changed since your experience? Yes Deeply faithful and live for God every day. What is your religion now? Moderate RELATIONSHIP WITH GOD AND BELIEF IN JESUS CHRIST AND DIED FOR ME ON A CROSS FOR MY SINS. Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes Deeply faithful and live for God every day. Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? Definite being, or voice clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see deceased or religious spirits? Sensed their presence Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? Yes I was filled with complete knowledge. Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes Love is most important and giving and caring and God is first. After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Yes It is impossible to express the feelings of love and wonder. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? My impact on others in this life, the love and peace, and God is real, death is a beginning, and Jesus died for our sins. Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes Limited. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? Yes I thought it was phony. What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real I wish I could say but you would have to experience it to know. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real I know what I experienced. At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? Yes Dreams. Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? I am more sensitive, I certainly have not had an easy life, I came back and my life has been very challenging. This experience has kept me going and centered. I am very aware of the spiritual realm and its more reality than our life here.

arrival.other_being_detail: Felt a presence on both sides; knew they were heavenly beings/angels. God spoke but was not seen.

environment.environment_other_detail: Entered a "beautiful garden" with "surreal" colors and scenery.

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Told by God her purpose was not finished; she would have children; she understood her purpose on Earth.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Criminal attack: drink spiked with "three hits of acid" and given enough alcohol to kill; heart stopped.

person_demographics.religious_affiliation_detail: Belief in Jesus Christ; described prior religion as "moderate" and now living for God every day.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE in hospital room, then tunnel and light, then life review and garden, then boundary/point of no return and return.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Reported later that parts were reproduced in dreams; stated she is "more sensitive" and "very aware of the spiritual realm" after returning.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "I started to race through the tunnel at an amazing speed"; "I was filled with total knowledge and understood everything"; "God spoke to me, but I could not see him"; "I entered my body quickly like bang."
